question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "**in**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the given passage is "calcium supplements."
 
• **In blank 2, a preposition will be used that will imply that the calcium supplements helps women to avoid osteoporosis.**
 
• **"In" is the most appropriate preposition to use in this context. **
 
 
• It indicates that something is located or contained within a particular space or area Or **it is used to show a state or condition.**
 
 
 
• Grammatically, "by", "out", and "into" do not convey the same meaning as "in" in this context.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, "by", is a preposition that typically indicates the means or method by which something is done or achieved (e.g. "I traveled to the airport by taxi").
 
• Option 3, "out", is a preposition that can indicate movement away from a particular space or area (e.g. "I walked out of the room"), but it does not convey the idea of filling something.
 
• Option 4, "into", is a preposition that typically indicates movement or direction towards a particular space or area (e.g. "I jumped into the pool").
